title: Market Research Analyst
description: A consumer packaged goods brand seeks a Market Research Analyst to study shopper behavior for its snack and beverage lines. You will run surveys, analyze retail scanner data, and present insights to the marketing team. Experience with consumer segmentation and advertising effectiveness is valued. You will work in Excel and Power BI.
